risk_note: F1-08cb (orchestrator D10-1517 batch 1 ③, D10-1734; landed per D10-1772, stacked on #184 F1-08ca and rebased onto main). Admin adjustments 新建调账 and 红冲: one-step submit that takes effect, SMS step-up code, contra subject with platform, pre-submit checks; amounts only through @couli/money. RELEASE GUARD (D10-1734 / D10-1798): after this merges and before F1-08ce merges, the admin app must not be promoted to production, because alone it lets an operator edit the form after a lost reply and resubmit with a new key (possible double adjustment); F1-08ce (locked form, retry with the original key and body only) lands right after. Codex is out of quota until 2026-11-20 (D10-1604), so per ops/approvals.yaml #36 the rule tests were written by an independent Claude (claude-run.sh, fresh context) in four rounds; another independent Claude spec-test r1 and r2 fail (S1), r3 pass with one S2 (fixture date not zero-padded for the 9th write), round 4 only pads that date. A fifth round (D10-1731 result-unknown lock) moved to F1-08ce because the per-task limit of 10 independent calls was reached (D10-1734). Implementation by Opus 5.5 (another context); after the rebase couli-ci verify:fast run 1 and --browser run 1 green. Money review r1 pass with two S2, both addressed by F1-08ce (D10-1731, D10-1732). Written by hand.
